column1: # Pre-registered fixture split for /goal v5. Written BEFORE the first
# intervention. Held-out fixtures are touched ONLY at checkpoints; touching one
# during an iteration invalidates the run.
# role=metric  contributes to marginal round gain and stall rate
# role=guard   sanity only, no metric contribution -- these pass at every budget
#              (plausible-wrong-fix was 6/6 in P17), so they can detect a
#              regression but never an improvement, and counting them would
